Hey there! I was browsing /all and saw this. So I lack some context of the sub, but I can tell enough by the name.

That being said, let me offer up some thoughts...

Relax. No, seriously. You stress your body and whatnot enough by being this stuck on it.

I obviously don't know you or where you are at, aside from posting in a sub like this. So that tells me something.

If you starve yourself, or fast...your body will react accordingly and slow your metabolism down. Which will make it harder to lose weight, if not put more on.

Give me a shot, and try something out...I call it the macro/micro managing technique. And it works a little like this...good thing is that you're halfway there (micro-managing).

When it gets frustrating, which it clearly seems to be, at the micro level, step back and zoom out to the bigger picture. Look at other areas of your life that ARE good. Work on something else.

That all being said, if you feel like sharing or chatting...feel free to ping me or reply. I don't know where you're at or what your goals are. You're clearly driven, which is great. But don't beat yourself up and understand that the body will seemingly work against your best efforts sometimes.

In any event, I wish you all the best and most of all...be good to yourself. :)
